versions.changelog:
Initial release providing automated capability decay detection and self-healing for skills.

- Monitors skill health by scanning learned_patterns.json for success rate drops and operation staleness.
- Generates alerts with suggested self-healing actions (repair, reinject learner, rerun regression).
- Integrates with meta-evolver to automatically track and repair decayed skills.
- Provides core APIs for skill health analysis and a CLI self-test.
- Fully configurable thresholds and actions; zero external dependencies.
